Title: Public Preview: Azure API Management Premium v2 Tier

Body.Content:
We are thrilled to introduce the Public Preview of the Azure API Management Premium v2 Tier, our most powerful, high-capacity option for managing APIs at enterprise scale. This tier is designed for organizations requiring enhanced performance, greater entity limits, unlimited API requests, and flexible networking options to meet the demands of modern, large-scale API environments. 

The Premium v2 tier builds on the strengths of our classic Premium offering, bringing advanced capabilities and increased flexibility for organizations operating robust API programs. 

How to Get Started 

The Premium v2 tier is currently available as a limited-access public preview. To request access to deploy a Premium v2 instance, please submit a request form. Approved requests will receive confirmation from the Azure API Management team within five business days. 

Learn more about this high-performance API management solution by exploring our API Management v2 FAQ and documentation. For pricing and availability, visit the API Management pricing page. More details on the announcement here.
